name: Friendzsoft Chatbot
author: optimisticmamun

sections.description:
Friendzsoft Chatbot enables you to add a customizable AI chatbot to your WordPress website. Built on OpenAI’s GPT models, it provides dynamic and conversational responses to user input.

Key Features:
– Integrates OpenAI GPT API (supports GPT-4, GPT-3.5-turbo)
– Floating chatbot widget
– Easy setup via admin dashboard
– Customizable title, logo, and appearance
– Designed for business websites, blogs, and support desks

Perfect for:
– Business support automation
– Smart user engagement
– Lead qualification and data collection

External Services

This plugin uses the OpenAI API, a third-party service, to generate chatbot responses.

Service Used: OpenAI API (https://platform.openai.com)
Data Sent: User messages entered into the chatbot interface
Purpose: To generate AI-based responses using GPT models
Service Provider: OpenAI, L.L.C.
Data Transmission Conditions: Data is sent only when a user interacts with the chatbot. The data is transmitted securely via HTTPS to the OpenAI servers.

No data is stored on our servers. The API key is provided and managed by the site administrator.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. See https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html for details.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip or install via WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Go to Friendzsoft Chatbot from your WordPress dashboard menu.
  4. Enter your OpenAI API key and adjust appearance as needed.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free to use?

Yes, the plugin is completely free and uses your own OpenAI API key.

Does it support GPT-4?

Yes, you can specify GPT-4 or GPT-3.5 in the settings.

Where can I get my OpenAI API key?

You can get your API key from https://platform.openai.com/account/api-keys

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes, it’s compatible with most caching plugins and themes.
